rotation.note: Unattended run: FULL gadgets keyword set used (core + every keyword in keyword_pool.sections.gadgets.keywords), not a date-rotated slice. Date-based rotation (day-of-month 18) is applied only to EMPHASIS ordering inside the query list: 18 mod 30 = 18 -> the query block leads with the wearables/XR/on-device-silicon slice (smart glasses, XR headset, NPU/edge chip) and trails with home-robot/appliance angles, so consecutive days open with a different face of the same pool.

Harvest each domain's RSS/Atom/news-sitemap first, keep items whose pubDate is inside the 336h (14-day) window, and only then use WebSearch queries to fill gaps.
